CXD-a3e04e475d3f184f.reviewTitle: Recurring Granite attention–MLP path as a specificity control
CXD-a3e04e475d3f184f.hypothesis: This layout may support a generic local routing step shared by prediction contexts in several task families.
CXD-a3e04e475d3f184f.alternative: Its recurrence in no-match and repeated-no-association conditions, as well as in Selection Frame, is consistent with a recurrent high-coverage component configuration.
CXD-a3e04e475d3f184f.proposedTest: Match query-token identity and prefix position across induction and no-match stimuli. Compare internal component coefficients while holding gate support and parent-record coverage visible.

CXD-ff8564930e5bf82d.hypothesis: PRE:3207 attention projections feed a MID:6020 readout at the final determiner that may prepare information about the referenced candidate.
CXD-ff8564930e5bf82d.alternative: The same path occurs in affirmative, negative and scope-control prompts, so article processing or query-template continuity can explain much of the recurrence.
CXD-ff8564930e5bf82d.proposedTest: Hold final 'the' and query syntax fixed, vary the referenced target and whether the same negated statement applies to that target, then compare the fixed downstream Gate projection.

CXD-9760e17982a8c61a.reviewTitle: Gemma eight-component determiner and local MLP integration
CXD-9760e17982a8c61a.hypothesis: An earlier MID:6020 MLP pair may supply information to PRE:3207 Q/K. The measured final MID:6020 Down target receives branches from Q and same-layer Gate/Up components.
CXD-9760e17982a8c61a.alternative: All four polarity and answer-swap conditions in the held-out group contain this path. A common determiner-triggered routing pattern, with independent Gate/Up effects, remains compatible.
CXD-9760e17982a8c61a.proposedTest: Keep the final token, syntax and candidate list fixed, swap the queried entity, and measure the L16 Down coefficient and the local Gate/Up branch readout in each condition.

CXD-1d7322926a89a591.reviewTitle: Granite attention convergence and MLP write
CXD-1d7322926a89a591.hypothesis: PRE:3207 Q components and a MID:6020 Up component may converge to prepare a candidate-query representation through the MID:4578 attention output and MLP Down targets.
CXD-1d7322926a89a591.alternative: SmolLM2 and Granite share the gate-labeled topology at three discovery anchors, while their held-out recurrence differs. Shared prompt format can generate the same topology.
CXD-1d7322926a89a591.proposedTest: Use unseen templates with equivalent queries and fixed terminal tokens. Check separate requirements for the readout and the MLP write under target and scope changes.

CXD-d6c066817f4bbfe3.reviewTitle: SmolLM2 counterpart of the Granite candidate-query topology
CXD-d6c066817f4bbfe3.hypothesis: L13–L14 Q and Up components may feed the candidate-query readout at L14 O and Down.
CXD-d6c066817f4bbfe3.alternative: Some matched affirmative or scope-control contexts also contain this circuit, and this exact component path has no held-out recurrence in the index.
CXD-d6c066817f4bbfe3.proposedTest: Test the same matched target and scope perturbations as for the Granite topology on new templates. Compare response directions for the two readouts separately.

CXD-650bfa991afe88c6.reviewTitle: SmolLM2 MLP convergence before a query projection
CXD-650bfa991afe88c6.hypothesis: Two MLP Down arms may combine before PRE:2152 reads a sentence-level representation at the ending anchor.
CXD-650bfa991afe88c6.alternative: The covered held-out sentences include carrying a book in active and passive voice, so generic clause closure or punctuation could account for the path.
CXD-650bfa991afe88c6.proposedTest: Keep the ending punctuation fixed and vary active/passive voice and agent–theme assignments across selection and non-selection templates.

CXD-0b022cc1e55bbeb6.reviewTitle: Granite composition of two sentence-period motifs
CXD-0b022cc1e55bbeb6.hypothesis: Two previously saved sentence-period motifs share an exact MLP Up component and may coordinate two attention-side readouts.
CXD-0b022cc1e55bbeb6.alternative: The Natural Validation graph archive lacks the exact text behind these 11 witnesses. Independent period-associated activation examples cannot verify their semantics.
CXD-0b022cc1e55bbeb6.proposedTest: Recover exact anchor text or construct matched period controls across clause completion, abbreviations and list punctuation. Measure the two readouts separately.

CXD-cfaacda2b24c56e3.reviewTitle: SmolLM2 bridge between demonstrative and discourse motifs
CXD-cfaacda2b24c56e3.hypothesis: The six-component bridge may connect a number-sensitive demonstrative route and a discourse-reference route through L09 attention readers.
CXD-cfaacda2b24c56e3.alternative: The four exact Natural Validation anchors have no linked text. A shared response to lexical This or These could explain the structural overlap.
CXD-cfaacda2b24c56e3.proposedTest: Cross demonstrative number with deictic versus discourse-reference use and freeze separate readouts for each branch before held-out evaluation.
